recordedProductIssues: Phone footage is cropped inside the card so the top border and the right side of the card look clipped; the screenshot on the phone is tiny
Heavy white cut-out and ring on the highlighted button

defects.problem: The phone card runs flush to the top, right and bottom edges with almost no margin, and its rounded corners touch the frame limits, so it feels cramped compared with the left panel's margin
defects.fix: Inset the phone card to match the 48px left gutter

defects.problem: The yellow margin bar beside the phone is only a thin sliver at the card edge and, at this size, reads more like a clipped border than a deliberate pointer; it does not obviously track the narration
defects.fix: Make the bar a touch longer and keep it visibly separated from the card edge

defects.problem: Phone-card text is readable but the embedded screenshot on the phone is too small for the highlighted button to be read
defects.fix: Give the phone card more width by shrinking the left panel slightly

defects.problem: Left panel swaps to the unredacted synthetic original while the phone stays dim, and the caption 'No subscription changed' fades to grey in sampling
defects.fix: Keep the caption at full contrast through its hold

couldNotAssess: Highlighter-bar motion timing relative to narration
oneLineVerdict: Strong, honest idea of showing the phone beside the picture; framing of the phone card is tight and the margin bar is subtle.
